verdict.rationale: All Gate 6 deliverables completed on real committed data with honest denominators: certification numbers with counts (strict 2/3, usable 2/3, silent failure 0/3 answered, coverage 3/3 dev trials on the latest canonical run), risk-coverage views refreshed and shown to reproduce the g20 artifacts exactly at RC head, high/medium/low routing verified on 33 real replay units with 0 violations, and the release thresholds frozen as a versioned, sha256-pinned gate BEFORE any holdout evaluation. What this session could NOT do (disclosed, not softened): run a fresh canonical cascade (Linux box has no canonical run dirs / Apple Vision — fresh `pnpm lab:cascade` here honestly reports n=0) or exercise the paddle-confirmed routing arm. The final GO/NO-GO for Gate 6 must come from the one-shot holdout evaluation on the canonical Mac environment judged against the frozen gate.
